review_notes: I reviewed all of the supplied file text (lines 1–90) and did not open any related sources. The file has about a dozen positivity and bound lemmas for the constants. Each is a short unfold followed by one or two `div_pos`, `mul_pos` or `Real.rpow_pos_of_pos` applications, with `linarith` or `norm_num` closing the side goals. The same combinators recur, but only as routine one-line positivity steps. The only repeated pattern is `Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _` followed by `mul_pos`, which is a short calculation, not nontrivial repeated reasoning. A shared lemma would not make the proofs easier to read or maintain, and it would amount to a thin wrapper around existing API. The lemmas `errorConstant_pos`, `hpConstant_pos`, `jpConstant_pos` and `gamma_pos` do have similar shapes. Their definitions differ, though, and I did not check the definitions in Geometry.lean, so the shapes could in principle hide a common factorisation. I could not justify a rubric finding from the file alone.
